reviews.author: James Mitchell

reviews.title: Works Native with Linux, driver is built into the kernel
reviews.comment: Some things I don't like...  Power consumption...  It would seem that 225W vs, nVidia's 125W for say, a 1660 Super might not be a good trade-off for some...  The length of the card could overwhelm some older motherboards/cases. Some things I like...  Works with the opensource drivers on Linux better than nVidia's opensource driver "non-attempt".  Has 2GB more memory and overall better support on Linux.
reviews.author: Biggs
